Definition: of uncertain affinity; to laugh (as a sign of joy or satisfaction):--laugh.
BiblicalUsage: geláō means laugh. It turns up twice, in Luke.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: geláō means laugh, and I do not stretch it further.
